_comment: NEW tab -- no real rows exist yet, so nothing here overwrites live data (unlike the UK/Poland unification). Column layout follows the established 'USA is the standard layout' precedent (see uk.json/poland.json's own _comment): same 23-column set as USA, with 'Country' in place of 'State' (matching UK/Poland, since Singapore is a client-billing entity like they are, not a US-state concept) and no VAT/GST column, because tax treatment was not specified by the user. Header wording mirrors UK's style (Client Name / Client Mail To / INT CC Mail / PF ID) since UK is the closest existing precedent for a non-US entity.
_tax_note: tax.type is set to 'none' as a DEFAULT, not a confirmed instruction -- the user only specified tab name, invoice numbering, and default currency (SGD). If Singapore invoices need GST (commonly 9%) added, tell me the rate and I'll add a GST column + update the tax block and the PDF entity config, the same way Poland's VAT rate was set explicitly.
_entity_pdf_note: This file only controls the tracker tab (Google Sheet columns + invoice numbering). A separate config/entities/singapore.json is required for PDF drafting (company legal name, address, bank details, tax treatment) and has NOT been created yet -- it needs real company/bank details that must come from you, not be guessed.
